note: Maya demo candles. "8 oz" and "12 oz" are jar capacities in fluid ounces, not wax weight. Jar and cap weights from Uline (rounded to 0.01 lb); wax from comparable CandleScience jars.

8oz.basis: Uline S-17983M-GLD 8 oz straight-sided jar with gold metal cap: unit weight 0.49 lb (jar + cap, stated) = 222.3 g; height with cap 3 9/16 in; diameter = cap diameter 2 7/8 in. Wax: 6.20 oz = 6.20 x 28.3495 = 175.8 g, taken from CandleScience's comparable 8 oz straight-sided jelly jar (8.30 fl oz overflow, same #70 cap size) because Uline gives no fill guidance. Total 222.3 + 175.8 = 398.0 g = 0.877 lb (about 14.0 oz). Wick, label and fragrance-load differences ignored (fragrance is part of the fill weight). is_estimate: wax weight is borrowed from a comparable jar; jar+lid weight is stated but rounded to 0.01 lb. Cross-check jar-only: O.Berk 1010071 200.2 g vs Uline S-25165 208.7 g. Fits Flush F0252-1F/1I cell (2.88 x 2.88 x 3.94 in) by dimensions, an inference: Flush does not list the Uline jar as compatible.

12oz.basis: Uline S-22916M-GLD 12 oz straight-sided jar with gold metal cap: unit weight 0.49 lb (jar + cap, stated) = 222.3 g; height with cap 3 1/4 in; diameter = cap diameter 3 1/4 in (Flush lists 3.34 in vessel diameter for its compatible 12 oz straight-sided jar group, so the glass body may be slightly wider than the cap). Wax: 8.50 oz = 8.50 x 28.3495 = 241.0 g, from CandleScience's Libbey Straight Sided Tumbler (12.10 fl oz overflow, fill-line wax 8.50 oz), a comparable 12 fl oz straight-sided jar. Total 222.3 + 241.0 = 463.2 g = 1.021 lb (about 16.3 oz). If filled closer to brim per GlassNow's 0.86 rule (10.32 oz = 292.6 g), total would be 514.8 g = 1.135 lb. is_estimate: wax borrowed from comparable jar; Uline weight rounded and suspiciously identical to the 8 oz model. Flush Packaging lists this exact Uline model as compatible with its F0190-1E single-jar box.

wax_fill_guidance.claim: CandleScience warns that container size names are not reliable: 'some of the size labels on the boxes do not reflect wax weight or overflow volume.' Wax weight is defined as 'Approximately how much wax by weight the container will hold' (an estimate).
wax_fill_guidance.notes: supplier. Page does not say whether '8 oz' means volume or wax weight, and gives no conversion multiplier.

wax_fill_guidance.claim: CandleScience '8 oz.' jelly jars hold 8.30 fl oz to overflow but 6.20 oz (175.77 g) of wax to the fill line.
wax_fill_guidance.notes: supplier. Same figures on the 8 oz Jelly Jar (1640) page. So for these jars '8 oz' is the jar capacity, and net wax is about 6.2 oz.

wax_fill_guidance.claim: CandleScience '12 oz.' Canning Jar holds 10.30 fl oz to overflow and 8.50 oz wax to fill line; the Libbey Straight Sided Tumbler holds 12.10 fl oz to overflow and 8.50 oz wax to fill line.
wax_fill_guidance.notes: supplier. Tumbler: https://www.candlescience.com/containers/straight-sided-tumbler-jar-libbey. Fill-line wax / overflow volume = 6.20/8.30 = 0.75 (8 oz jelly), 8.50/12.10 = 0.70 (tumbler).

wax_fill_guidance.claim: Uline jar capacities are 'Measured in fluid ounces.'
wax_fill_guidance.notes: supplier. Confirms the jar-side '8 oz'/'12 oz' convention is volume.

wax_fill_guidance.claim: GlassNow: container size is 'typically provided in fluid ounces (FL OZ.) or milliliters (ML)'; 'Wax Weight (oz) = Container Volume (fl oz) x Wax Density'; 'a good rule of thumb is to use .86'; example '9 fluid oz candle jar is 7.74 oz (9 x .86 = 7.74)'.
wax_fill_guidance.notes: supplier. The 0.86 rule gives wax to the brim; real fills stop below the rim, which is why CandleScience fill-line figures are lower (ratio about 0.70 to 0.75). 8 x 0.86 = 6.88 oz; 12 x 0.86 = 10.32 oz (brimful upper bounds).

wax_fill_guidance.claim: Candles and Supplies: 11.5 oz Clear Straight Sided Tumbler 'Holds 8-9 oz. of wax comfortably.'
wax_fill_guidance.notes: supplier. Another example of a jar named by volume holding about 0.7 to 0.8 of that in wax weight.
